column1: # si/units-run.tsv: the units si/units-gate.om executes after building them (NAME run LINE, or NAME not_run REASON).
# run: SCRATCH/NAME.1 with no arguments, stdin /dev/null, from the repository root; it must exit 0, write no stderr,
# and its last non-empty stdout line must be LINE exactly. not_run: built only, printed NOT_RUN, never a pass.
# Every unit whose name ends in _test needs a row.
# The two rosetta rows are task programs, not suites: they print no verdict line, so the row pins their last
# result line (the full list of Mersenne exponents; the last of 13 Miller-Rabin verdicts). An earlier line can regress unseen.
rosetta_tasks_lucas_lehmer_test_lucas_lehmer_test run M2 M3 M5 M7 M13 M17 M19 M31 M61
seed_challenge_test run SEED-CHALLENGE TEST SUITE PASS (10/10)
homebrew_formula_test run HOMEBREW-OMEGA TEST SUITE PASS (7/7)
harvester_test run HARVESTER TEST SUITE PASS (7/7)
aien_harness_test run AIEN-HARNESS TEST SUITE PASS (8/8)
agent_archive_test run SUMMARY agent-archive PASS all=8 fail=0
arch_verify_test run PASS aien-architecture-verify all 7 test suites passed
bench_verify_test run PASS benchmarks-verify all 7 test suites passed
